scripts.title: VALOR HUB -  - FREE KEY ESP, AIM ASSIST,MORE
scripts.features:
Visuals

ESP: players highlighted through walls, with name, health and distance (enemies crimson, teammates blue), an enemies-only switch and an opacity slider.
Tracers: a line from the bottom of the screen to each player.
Wider field of view: up to +40°, applied through the game's own camera, so it doesn't snap back.
Target info: name, health and distance of the enemy nearest your crosshair.
Custom crosshair: size and gap sliders.

Aim

Targeting settings shared by both aim features: cone size, head or body, visible targets only, movement prediction, extra lead, and stickiness (no flicking between players).
Show aim cone: draws the cone as a ring on screen.
Aim assist (moderate ban risk): gently pulls your view onto the target while you hold a key (right mouse, Q, E or Alt, or always on). It's built to look human, with a reaction delay, a speed cap and slight wander. On phones it works while you hold the game's Shoot or Aim button.
Silent aim (high ban risk): while you hold fire, it turns onto the target so the shot lands, then gives your view back.
No recoil / no spread (moderate-high ban risk): applies to every weapon after you re-equip it.

Move (all high or very high ban risk)

Speed boost up to 60.
Fly: keyboard controls, or the move stick on phones.
Noclip.

Server

Anti-AFK (on by default).
Server hop (random or smallest server) and rejoin.
Self-check: a read-only test showing which features work in your server, with a Copy button.

Safety built in

Nothing ever prints to the console.
Everything the panel draws is kept out of the places the game checks.
Aim goes through the game's own camera controller.
The panel sends no network traffic of its own.
It avoids the game's traps: its own auto-shoot and its "cheater" flag.

scripts.title: VEIL |  - Silent Aim, ESP, Anti Katana 2026
scripts.features:
VEIL — Features

Silent Aim — Redirects outgoing rays to your locked target. Hit chance slider, FOV control, Head/UpperTorso/Chest/Random targeting. Requires executor with namecall hook support.

Aimbot — Camera-based target lock with adjustable smoothing curve from snap to glide. FOV priority, weapon profiles (AR/Sniper/SMG/Shotgun/Pistol auto-detect), rotate-character toggle, always-on mode.

Aim Lock — Harder aim assist, no mouse override while locked. Tighter curve than standard aimbot.

Ragebot — Snap aim, no visible check, max FOV. For when you want it obvious.

ESP — Boxes, names, health bars, distance, skeleton bones. Full RGB color picker for boxes, names, and skeleton. Adjustable render distance and FPS-scaled update rate.

ESP Target Visibility — Colors box green when target is visible, red when occluded behind cover.

Viewmodel Chams — Neon material on your held weapon. Optional visibility coloring tied to lock target.

Triggerbot — Auto-fire on raycast hit. Adjustable delay, max distance, proximity fallback for close targets, visible check.

No Recoil — Zeroes camera kick, stops recoil animation tracks, neutralizes tool recoil values. Three-part suppression.

Anti Flash — Live sweep + instant gate on flash/blind effects in Lighting, PlayerGui, and Workspace. Catches flashes that re-enable on existing instances.

Anti Katana Deflect — Auto-disables your tool when a katana/parry target is locked, re-enables when safe. Prevents self-counter.

Hitbox Expander — Scales Head/Torso/Root hitboxes on all players. Adjustable size multiplier.

Rapid Fire — Minimum fire delay override. Triggerbot integration.

Max Accuracy / No Spread — Bullet speed set to max, spread zeroed, prediction tightened.

Spinbot — Body gyro rotation while not locked. HvH-flavored.

Fly — BodyVelocity movement with WASD + Space/Ctrl. Shift for 2x speed. Weapon-lock option. PC only.

Speed Hack — WalkSpeed override with BodyVelocity assist for consistent motion across slopes.

Infinite Jump — Space re-triggers jump state while held or recently tapped.

Fly Noclip — CanCollide disabled on all character parts while flying.

Night Vision — Ambient boost, shadow disable, green ColorCorrection overlay. Toggleable.

Sky Changer — Replaces Lighting Sky with a custom skybox.

Custom Crosshair — Clean 4-arm crosshair with outline and center dot. Replaces default.

Hit Sounds — Audio feedback on confirmed hits. Five options: Vine Boom, Mega Knight, MLG Airhorn, Boom Headshot, Taco Bell.

FPS Boost — Culls particles, beams, lights, disables GlobalShadows, quality to Level01, kills post-FX. Big frame gains in crowded fights.

Config Save/Load — Every setting persists to disk. Weapon profiles save smoothing, FOV, prediction, lead, bullet speed.

Full UI — Tabbed interface: Visuals, Combat, Silent, Trigger, Mods, Config. Draggable, bind-toggleable.

Key System — 24h free tier, premium tiers (1 week / 1 month / 3 months). Redeem in-game under Config → Premium Key.

Works On — PC (Windows), Mobile (Android/iOS executors), Emulators (auto-detected, uses PC bindings).
